prompt: Build an original portfolio for a two-person architecture studio. Use the supplied project descriptions, give one project visual priority, and make project navigation usable on phones. Include no invented awards or client claims.

Build a landing page for a desktop note-search tool. Explain the problem and workflow with a useful product demonstration, then offer a real demo action. Include a static alternative to any animation.
Build a storefront for six handmade lamps with supplied names, prices, and photos. Provide category filtering, an empty state, and a clear inquiry flow without pretending to process payments.
Adapt a supplied nonprofit page for long translated headlines, missing images, and 200 percent zoom while retaining a clear hierarchy and usable donation navigation.

Implement a stdlib CLI that reads a UTF-8 JSON array of inventory items with unique nonempty IDs and nonnegative integer quantities. Reject booleans, duplicates, malformed JSON, and unknown fields. Emit deterministic totals and distinct invalid-input exit behavior.
checks: No traceback for expected input errors

prompt: Implement a report writer that writes UTF-8 output to a caller-selected path, refuses to overwrite existing data by default, and reports I/O failure. Keep report formatting independently testable.
Refactor an existing script that mixes parsing, calculation, and printing into a small testable module while preserving its documented CLI behavior. Avoid unnecessary framework or class hierarchies.

Design and implement a pagination collector against an injected fake API client. Handle an empty page, repeated cursor, malformed response, and bounded maximum pages; do not make real network requests.
